WITH rating_averages AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_rate_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost <= 20.99
    AND rental_rate IS NOT NULL
    AND rental_duration IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY rating
), overall_average AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS mean_rating_average
  FROM rating_averages
)
SELECT r.rating,
       r.avg_rate_per_day AS average,
       r.avg_rate_per_day - o.mean_rating_average AS above_overall_mean
FROM rating_averages r
CROSS JOIN overall_average o
WHERE o.mean_rating_average IS NOT NULL
  AND r.avg_rate_per_day > o.mean_rating_average;
